description: This file defines a Java interface named CustomerDAO responsible for data access operations related to Customer entities in the sales management system. It extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods for retrieving customers by various criteria, such as name, nickname, and store-specific filters.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Customer objects matching the provided name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Customer objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer by their nickname.

methods.name: listByStore (with CustomerCriteria)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Customer objects for a store that match the given criteria.

methods.name: getByNick (with storeId)
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer by nickname within a specific store identified by storeId.
